name: Call Front Ratio Spread (1x2)
summary: Buy 1 nearer call and sell 2 further OTM calls for a credit; profits from a drift up to the short strike, with unlimited risk above it.

legs.strike_rule: ATM or slightly ITM, call delta 0.50-0.60
OTM strike at call delta 0.25-0.30, chosen so the package opens at a net credit

when_to_use: COMPLETENESS / LEVEL 4: IV rank > 50 with elevated call skew and a target price at the short strike. One of the two short calls is uncovered, so the structure is unlimited-risk and requires level 4. Under Level 3, trade the broken-wing call butterfly instead - it is the same thesis with the tail capped.
max_profit: (short strike - long strike) x 100 + net credit, at the short strike
breakevens: downside: none when opened for a credit; upside breakeven = short strike + (short strike - long strike) + credit/100

greeks.delta: positive at entry, turns negative above the short strike

entry_rules: BLOCKED AT LEVEL 3: 2 short calls against 1 long leaves one uncovered call; requires Alpaca level 4. Router must reject at Level 3.
Level 4 version: open for a net credit only - never a debit; short strike delta <= 0.30; IV rank >= 50.
Level-3 substitute (preferred): add a long call above the shorts at the same distance, converting this into a broken-wing call butterfly with identical directional character and a capped tail.
management_rules: Level 4 only: close at 50% of max profit.
Level 4 only: close if spot trades above the short strike, and always close at 21 DTE.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: 2 short calls, 1 uncovered; flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the short calls are ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before every ex-dividend date when the short calls are ITM.
assignment_risk: Assignment on both short calls delivers -200 shares per unit, covered by only 1 long call; the residual is a naked 100-share short. Unacceptable at Level 3 and dangerous at Level 4.
buying_power: Naked short call margin on the uncovered contract plus the debit spread's cost.
common_mistakes: Opening for a debit, which creates a loss zone on the downside as well as the unlimited one above; assuming the long call 'covers' both shorts.
zero_dte_notes: Not permitted here - uncovered short call at 0DTE.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
